description: This file defines the interface 'Authenticated' in the OpenMRS API, representing the result of an authentication process. It provides methods to retrieve the authentication scheme used and the authenticated user.

classes.name: Authenticated
classes.description: An interface representing the result of an authentication process, providing methods to access the authentication scheme details and the authenticated user.

methods.name: getAuthenticationScheme
methods.description: Returns a string describing or identifying the authentication scheme that was used.
